text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is over—!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
“Still, there's still the bus ride home, huh.
Ugh, tired by 20 miles~...”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan does prefer
staying on the move, after all...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't it be best to just go to sleep?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Chrono, you're heading on a trip to Hokkaido after this, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: 50 miles, I'm so jealous!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
If Gran-chan goes too... ah,
she's running in the Sprinters Stakes, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The actual race is in September—timing-wise,
we need to start making adjustments soon, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yep. But I'm really looking forward to the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
'Cause I get to run with
Senior Class Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu, looking forward to it? That's so like you, Gran-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Facing off against the Senior Class...
Eventually, we'll be facing Ms. Eye too—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
However... before that,
comes the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Loves-chan, Bouquet-san.
Let us have a battle worthy of the final Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah, just what I was hoping for!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I shall showcase—
the fruits of our summer training camp, in their entirety.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The Shuka Sho is the culmination of the Triple Tiara.
Let's make it a race that defines our generation!"
And then, the first day back after the break—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
thank you so much for the day off!
choice_data_list: How was your trip to Hokkaido?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
At the foot of Mount Yotei,
I fully enjoyed the sacred grounds of the Mejiro family...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Y-You're right...!
I had a relaxing time with my family.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The food was delicious everywhere I went.
I ended up overeating a little...
choice_data_list: It's good to eat plenty around this time of year.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But, um...
I am well aware that I've been living... unhealthily...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to trim down and tone up
for the Shuka Sho...!"
